verdict.rationale: Lovable's Build/Agent mode explicitly supports sending follow-up prompts, corrections, or new ideas while it works, letting founders steer iteratively (lovable-docs-4, lovable-docs-30). However, there is no documentation or evidence specifically addressing regression safety—i.e., that follow-up edits won't break existing functionality—and community reports note quality issues (code abusing 'any' types, unwieldy single-file structure) that suggest iterative changes can introduce fragility (lovable-comm-9, lovable-comm-10). Missing for 10: explicit regression-testing/versioning safeguards, docs on preserving prior behavior during edits, and hands-on confirmation that iteration doesn't break prior features.
